================================================================================
MySQL: hash comments and backticks
:language(usql_mysql)
================================================================================

select `a;b`, `x``y` # a comment; select 2
from t /* c */;
select $$a;b$$, 1 // 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier)
    (quoted_identifier)
    (comment)
    (comment))
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL: a backtick with no end
:language(usql_mysql)
================================================================================

select `abc;
\g

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier)))

================================================================================
MySQL: meta commands and variables
:language(usql_mysql)
================================================================================

select :id, `:x` # :y
\g

================================================================================
SQLite: backticks
:language(usql_sqlite)
================================================================================

select `a;b` /* c; */ from t # d;
select $$a;b$$;

  (statement))

================================================================================
Standard: block comments only
:language(usql_standard)
================================================================================

select `a;b`, $$c;d$$ /* e; */ # f; g // h;

================================================================================
CQL: dollar quotes and slash comments
:language(usql_cql)
================================================================================

select $$a;b$$ // c; d
from t /* e; */ -- f;
;
select `g;h`;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (dollar_string)
    (comment)
    (comment)
    (comment))
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
CQL: a batch
:language(usql_cql)
================================================================================

BEGIN BATCH
  INSERT INTO t (a) VALUES (:a);
APPLY BATCH;

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Plain: no block comments
:language(usql_plain)
================================================================================

select 1 /* a; */ -- b;
;

================================================================================
Plain: dollar signs and backticks are text
:language(usql_plain)
================================================================================

select $$a;b$$, `c;d`;
